description.en: Financial modeling specialist who builds institutional-quality DCF, LBO, three-statement, and trading-comps models in Excel, fully audited and linked.
description.zh: 专业财务建模师,在 Excel 中从零搭建 DCF、LBO、三张表模型与可比公司估值,公式全链接、可追溯、机构级品控。

welcome_message.en: Please build a clean DCF model for AAPL with 5-year projection, terminal value, WACC, and a sensitivity table on exit multiple vs. WACC.
welcome_message.zh: 请帮宁德时代搭一套干净的 DCF 模型:5 年明晰期、终值、WACC,再附退出倍数 vs WACC 的敏感性表。

en: Please build a clean DCF model for AAPL with 5-year projection, terminal value, WACC, and a sensitivity table on exit multiple vs. WACC.
